newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean firms to seek 40,000 tonnes of tapioca.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean firms to seek 40,000 tonnes of tapioca.

text.p: A South Korean feed grain buyer group, known as the Feed Buying Group, has invited tenders to buy 40,000 tonnes of tapioca by 3:00 p.m. (0600 GMT) on Friday, traders said on Thursday.

They said the tender was split into three lots: one for 12,000 tonne for arrival by May 10, the other for 14,000 tonnes for arrival by June 10 and another for 14,000 tonnes for arrival by July 10 to the western port of Inchon.
They added another buyer group, known as the Big Feed Mills, bought 7, 500 tonnes of Thai tapioca from Soon Hwa Seng at $87.50 a tonne C&F.
Shipment was set for May 1-20 to the two ports of Inchon and Kunsan.
